text:
Marta: Heads-up — after the FP8/auto-calib rollout last night on staging-dedicated we see a clear perf/quality regression on one of our structured-output evals. latency p95 jumped and some JSON fields are missing in outputs. :frowning:
Will: ugh. can you paste the eval delta and a quick repro? :eyes:
Marta: Eval diff (staging vs previous):
- structured-schema-pass_rate: 0.87 -> 0.77 (-10ppt)
- rougeL: 0.58 -> 0.56
- hallucination rate (entity-level): 2.3% -> 6.8%
Also p95 latency for short seqs (~64 tokens) went 9ms -> 21ms.
Sam: any kernel fallbacks in the profiler? that latency jump smells like fallback/shape penalty or suboptimal kernel selection when quantized.
Marta: attaching a tiny profiler dump snippet:```
matmul_kernel: chosen=fp8_gemm_128x256 name=matmul_fp8_fast
layer=23 shape=[64,1024]->[1024,4096]
perf_est_ms=8.7 actual_ms=22.1 fallback_reason=accumulator_overflow
kv_cache: evictions=0.003 miss_rate=0.11
kv_indexing: avg_lookup_ms=0.42
```
Will: accumulator_overflow -> fallback to fp32 accumulator path? that explains perf. but why quality regressions and JSON fields missing?
Yuki: two hypotheses: 1) calibration mismatch for that layer caused representational clipping -> structured tokens unstable. 2) KV cache interop bug: when quantized keys are stored, the lookup tolerance changed and caused off-by-one past indexing for long prompts -> wrong past tokens used -> hallucinations.
Claire: I saw similar in a canary a few weeks ago but that was int8 calibration. We added a subtle rounding fix in kv index hashing then. Did the FP8 rollout include the kv hashing change?
Marta: FP8 rollout included auto-calib + kernel selector change. KV hashing change was not in that deploy.
Sam: can we reproduce locally with a small script? Marta, can you run eval with env flags: USE_FP8=true, FORCE_KERNEL=fallback, KV_QUANT_MODE=trace and paste the output?
Marta: running now, will paste results.
infra-bot: deploy noted: FP8-auto-calib rollout started by @deploy-bot at 1769319900. Canary group: 10% tenants.
Marta: quick repro run output:```
> python repro.py --seed=42 --prompt-set=structured
structured_pass: 0.76
missing_fields_examples: 3/50
prof_top:
 layer23: kernel=fallback_fp32_accum ms=24.5
 layer23: quant_clip_min=-0.0035 quant_clip_max=0.0033
 kv_lookup_mismatches: 6
```
Will: ok that's actionable. Sam, Yuki — can you take kernel selector and kv lookup codepath? I suspect fallback condition triggers because accum range after quantization exceeds fp8 accumulator dynamic range, which causes selector to choose slower fp32 path. For quality, the clip range asymmetric sounds off.
Yuki: I'll look at the calibration output. If the calib stats used per-channel vs global were mixed up we'll get asymmetric clipping. Also will instrument kv store to log raw int8 keys vs unquantized floats.
Sam: I'll add a test that forces the fallback and asserts outputs match baseline within tolerance for structured tokens. If it fails we can block the rollout.
Claire: short-term mitigation: revert auto-calib for that model or pin to int8/4bit profile that previously passed structured eval. We should also add a canary check for structured schema pass_rate before full rollout.
Marta: agreed. Action items: 1) Yuki inspects calibration dump (calib_176931*), 2) Sam adds forced-fallback regression test, 3) Will drafts rollback if canary fails in next hour. I'll leave the repro logs in /tmp/repro-1769321210.log.
Will: ping me when tests are green/failing. tagging @eng-oncall if rollback needed. :thumbsup:
Marta: thanks all. I'll keep posting updates.```
